description: This file defines a class 'ClusterMembershipUpdate' that encapsulates a snapshot of cluster membership state along with any changes. It provides properties to access the snapshot, the changes, and whether any changes exist.

classes.name: ClusterMembershipUpdate
classes.description: Represents a cluster membership snapshot and changes from a previous snapshot, providing access to the snapshot, changes, and change detection.

methods.name: ClusterMembershipUpdate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the update with a snapshot and a list of changed members.

methods.name: HasChanges
methods.description: Indicates whether there are any changes in the membership update.
